caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #148: PERNICIOUS

pernicious (adjective): harmful, especially in a gradual or hidden way.

✅ In a sentence: Misinformation can have a pernicious effect on public trust.
✅ Similar: harmful, destructive, insidious
✅ Remember it: Close to "insidious": both mean sneaky harm.
